name: Amy
source: A girl that works at Sunny Shine Funland. She is one of the newer workers at the amusement park. Her favorite ride is the merry-go-round. Amy greets people and welcomes them to the park. Additionally, she works at one of the ticket booths. Amy hopes to stay on Mr. Wazlow's good side.
